title: Uniform Time Extent
description: Uniformly sampled timesteps implicitly defined by scalar start_time and sampling_period without explicit columnar data.

start_time.description: Start time of the first observation in seconds.

sampling_period.description: Sampling period (time step) between consecutive observations in seconds.

disjoint.description: Uniformly sampled times are implicitly disjoint.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether the sampled timesteps cover the time range without gaps.

min_time.description: Lower bound of the time extent in seconds.

max_time.description: Upper bound of the time extent in seconds.
